title: Guarded Switch
summary: Puts a lift-up cover over a critical switch like maintenance mode or a kill switch, so a stray click can't flip it.
description: Toggle for critical settings with a see-through cover, like an aircraft switch guard: lift it first, it states what flipping will do while open, drops back on its own after a few seconds, and reads back the consequence after the change. Red tone for irreversible effects.
catches: Stray click or tap on a critical toggle
Flipping without knowing the effect: the on/off consequence is shown while the guard is up
Guard left open: it closes again on its own
A rejected change keeps the old state
limits: A deliberate user can still flip it; it adds friction, not authorization
Does not confirm who flipped it or log the change
a11y: The switch has role=switch, aria-checked, a label and a description; it is out of the tab order until the cover is lifted
Cover is a button with aria-expanded and an aria-label; Escape closes it and focus moves sensibly between cover and switch
Effect line is a polite live region
Pending state uses aria-busy; icons are aria-hidden
server: Authorize and audit-log the setting change on the server.
stops: Helps prevent a kill switch flipped by accident
